name: WhatsApp
label: WhatsApp — WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta Graph v26.0)
description: WhatsApp via the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta Graph v26.0). Base https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0. Docs: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/overview/. Canonical Cloud API node; social-media.md is discovery only — same folder nodes/whatsapp. DO NOT BUILD unofficial WhatsApp Web / Baileys / session scrape. 24h customer-care window vs templates. Twilio WhatsApp is the twilio node. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secrets (app_secret, verify_token) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event); selecting the :send_and_wait operation (send-and-wait) performs the outbound send and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One WhatsApp operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | send-template | upload-media | download-media | delete-media | send-and-wait | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port); send-and-wait (:send_and_wait role) sends the outbound message and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply. Example: first verb.

schema.label: to
schema.description: WhatsApp recipient (E.164 without +). Required on send-template; used on send-message. Example: 15551234567.

schema.label: type
schema.description: send-message: message type, EXACT text | image | audio | document | video | location | interactive (e.g. text). send-template: sends template when blank. upload-media: MIME type of the file (e.g. image/jpeg).

schema.label: text
schema.description: Text body object {body} or a string the engine sends as text.body depending on type=text. send-message. Example: {"body":"Hello"}.

schema.label: template
schema.description: Template object {name, language:{code}, components?} for send-template. Escape hatch: template_name and language are merged into it. Example: {"name":"hello_world","language":{"code":"en_US"},"components":[]}.

schema.label: template_name
schema.description: Approved template name for send-template, sent as template.name. Example: hello_world.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Template language/locale code for send-template, sent as template.language.code (required by the Cloud API; must match an approved translation). Example: en_US.

schema.label: media_id
schema.description: Graph media id for download-media / delete-media. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Media file for upload-media (multipart field file). Platform file block. Official Cloud API POST /{phone_number_id}/media. Example: an image/jpeg.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) and matched webhook replies (:send_and_wait) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, send-template, upload-media, download-media, delete-media, send-and-wait, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (app_secret, verify_token), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event; selecting send-and-wait (:send_and_wait role) reveals the same webhook fields, sends the outbound message, and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply.

configurationParameters.label: Meta access token
configurationParameters.description: Meta system-user (or user) access token for WhatsApp Cloud API. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. App secret stays on the ingress verifier, not this HTTP call. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: phone_number_id
configurationParameters.description: WhatsApp Business phone-number id (Graph path). Required for send/upload.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Meta App Secret
configurationParameters.description: Meta App Secret for constant-time X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 verification on inbound WhatsApp webhooks. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Verify Token
configurationParameters.description: Shared verify token checked during Meta GET hub.mode=subscribe handshake (hub.verify_token). Never logged.
